items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: No, just on the basis of Ray, because Ray knows me

ctx.x: And you tried him -- did you listen to him before you hired him.

No, just on the basis of Ray, because Ray knows me and I knew he had been studying and he was one of Ray's pupils and he was there, something anyway, if it didn't fit me, but I just like him. He fits the rhythm section and fits the band, I think, and I think after we work together after awhile, we'll become a team.
He sounds great for the band, in fact it's almost like he's featured, the bass is featured the way you have it at Westbury.
